$comment: Declarative architecture-boundary policy enforced in CI by check-imports.mjs. Codifies the invariants in docs/architecture/22-BOUNDED-CONTEXTS.md and 23-SERVICE-OWNERSHIP.md. Editing a rule here is an architecture change — record it via an ADR.

shared.description: Cross-cutting shared libraries (e.g. @vip/contracts). Importable by anything. Must NOT import services or plugins.

service.description: Bounded-context services. May import shared libs only. Must reach other services via API/events, never by importing their internals.

plugin.description: Industry packs, connectors, model providers. May import shared libs (and their own SDK). The core must never import a plugin.

tool.description: Repo tooling. Not part of the runtime dependency graph.

noDeepImports.description: Import a workspace package by its public entry point only — never a deep path into its internals (e.g. @vip/contracts, not @vip/contracts/src/events/envelope). Preserves each package's encapsulation and its right to refactor internals.

noCoreToPlugin.description: The core (shared libs + services) must never depend on a plugin. Industries/connectors/models are pluggable; the core stays industry-agnostic (Law 1).

noCrossServiceInternals.description: A service must not import another service's code. Cross-context communication is API/events only, so contexts stay independently deployable (22 golden rule, 23 no-shared-code).

noCycles.description: The workspace package dependency graph must remain acyclic (23 §no-cycles invariant).
